remarks: Welcome to 11129 Bunker Lane, a beautifully renovated, move-in-ready residence in the desirable Candlewood Villas community of Whittier, conveniently located near Candlewood Country Club and its picturesque golf course! Built in 2019 and extensively updated in 2026, this two-story, townhome-style condominium offers approximately 1,370 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. Step inside to discover a bright, open-concept floor plan featuring brand-new flooring throughout, freshly painted walls and ceilings, and newly installed recessed lighting that creates a modern and inviting atmosphere.
